configuration_map: No geometric configuration. The proof operates entirely on abstract magnitudes and their multiples. Points A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R are labels for positions along one-dimensional magnitudes (like marks on a number line), not points in a plane or space. No triangle interiors, circle positions, angle decompositions, or ray orderings are involved.
skip_reason: Book 5 is proportions theory. Proposition 5.1 proves that if AB = n*CD and AE = n*CF, then the remainder EB = n*(remainder FD). The proof is purely algebraic, manipulating abstract magnitudes via Common Notions (equality subtraction, addition) and Definition 5.2 (multiples). No geometric spatial claims are made.
